# API endpoint inventory

<!-- Generated by tools/endpoint-inventory/generate.mjs from docs/openapi.json and tools/endpoint-inventory/decisions.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every operation the backend serves, grouped by resource, with the decision taken on each set of duplicates (#250). Regenerate with `node tools/endpoint-inventory/generate.mjs`; the docs-drift tests fail when this file is stale, when a v1/v2 twin has no decision, or when the operations marked `deprecated` in the spec differ from the decisions.

## Summary

| | Operations |
|---|---:|
| `/api/v1` | 265 |
| `/api/v2` | 24 |
| **Total** | **289** |
| Deprecated | 22 |
| After the sunset on 2027-05-14 | 267 |

Deprecated operations still work until the sunset. Every response from one carries `Deprecation`, `Sunset` and a `Link: <successor>; rel="successor-version"` header, and the OpenAPI document marks it `deprecated: true`. See [API deprecations](upgrading/api-deprecations.md) for how to move.

| `GET /api/v1/artifacts/{sha256}/provenance`<br>`GET /api/v2/artifacts/{sha256}/provenance` | deprecate | `GET /api/v2/artifacts/{sha256}/provenance` |  |
| `GET /api/v1/flows`<br>`GET /api/v2/flows` | deprecate | `GET /api/v2/flows` |  |

| `GET /api/v1/flows/{id}`<br>`GET /api/v2/flows/{id}` | deprecate | `GET /api/v2/flows/{id}` |  |

| `GET /api/v1/trails/{id}/audit`<br>`GET /api/v2/trails/{id}/audit` | deprecate | `GET /api/v2/trails/{id}/audit` |  |
| `GET /api/v1/trails/{trailId}/artifacts`<br>`GET /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/artifacts` | deprecate | `GET /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/artifacts` |  |
| `GET /api/v1/trails/{trailId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/provenance`<br>`GET /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/provenance` | deprecate | `GET /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/provenance` |  |
| `GET /api/v1/trails/{trailId}/attestations`<br>`GET /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/attestations` | deprecate | `GET /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/attestations` | v1 returns a page object; v2 returns a JSON array and, with `page`/`size`, the total in `X-Total-Count`. |
| `POST /api/v1/flows`<br>`POST /api/v2/flows` | deprecate | `POST /api/v2/flows` | v2 returns `{id, status}` instead of the flow; read it back with `GET /api/v2/flows/{id}`. |
| `POST /api/v1/trails`<br>`POST /api/v2/trails` | deprecate | `POST /api/v2/trails` | v2 returns `{id, status}` instead of the trail; read it back with `GET /api/v2/trails/{id}`. |
| `POST /api/v1/trails/{trailId}/artifacts`<br>`POST /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/artifacts` | deprecate | `POST /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/artifacts` | v2 returns `{id, status}` instead of the artifact. |
| `POST /api/v1/trails/{trailId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/provenance`<br>`POST /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/provenance` | deprecate | `POST /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/provenance` |  |
| `POST /api/v1/trails/{trailId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/provenance/verify`<br>`POST /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/provenance/verify` | deprecate | `POST /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/provenance/verify` |  |
| `POST /api/v1/trails/{trailId}/attestations`<br>`POST /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/attestations` | deprecate | `POST /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/attestations` | v2 returns `{id, status}` instead of the attestation. |
| `POST /api/v1/trails/{trailId}/attestations/{attestationId}/evidence`<br>`POST /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/attestations/{attestationId}/evidence` | deprecate | `POST /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/attestations/{attestationId}/evidence` | v2 returns `{id, status}`; the file's hash, name and size are on the attestation (`GET /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/attestations`). |
| `POST /api/v1/trails/{trailId}/attestations/pull-request`<br>`POST /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/attestations/pull-request` | deprecate | `POST /api/v2/trails/{trailId}/attestations/pull-request` |  |
| `PUT /api/v1/flows/{id}`<br>`PUT /api/v2/flows/{id}` | deprecate | `PUT /api/v2/flows/{id}` | v2 returns `{id, status}` instead of the flow; read it back with `GET /api/v2/flows/{id}`. |
| `POST /api/v1/assert`<br>`POST /api/v1/trails/{trailId}/assert` | keep | all | Different questions: `/assert` judges an artifact digest against a flow (latest evidence for that digest); `/trails/{trailId}/assert` judges one pipeline run. Neither is a subset of the other. |
| `GET /api/v1/metrics/compliance`<br>`GET /api/v1/reports/compliance`<br>`GET /api/v1/dashboard/stats` | keep | all | Real overlap: `/dashboard/stats` and `/metrics/compliance` both return trail compliance totals (metrics adds attestation counts), while `/reports/compliance` breaks the same figures down per flow for auditors. Kept for this release because the web dashboard reads `/dashboard/stats`; next candidate for deprecation once the dashboard reads `/metrics/compliance`. |
| `POST /api/v1/gate/evaluate`<br>`POST /api/v1/queries/gates/evaluate` | keep | all | `/gate/evaluate` applies deployment policies attached to an environment (used by `factstore gate` and the policies tutorial). `/queries/gates/evaluate` evaluates the gate with risk-tier fallback when the server cannot answer (docs/gates.md). Candidate to merge once deployment policies move onto the gate engine. |
| `GET /api/v1/policies`<br>`GET /api/v1/deployment-policies`<br>`GET /api/v1/opa/bundles` | keep | all | Three policy models with different inputs: attestation requirement policies, environment deployment policies, and OPA/Rego bundles. Consolidating them is a product decision outside #250. |

Why the v1 twins are deprecated: Same method and path on v1 and v2. v2 is the command/query API that appends to the event log and feeds the query service's projections; v1 writes do not. Decided on #250 to keep v2.

## Finding unused routes

Request counts per route are in the `http_server_requests_seconds_count` metric at `/actuator/prometheus`, labelled by `method` and `uri` (the path template, as in the tables below). A route with no requests over a release cycle is a candidate for deprecation; record the decision in `tools/endpoint-inventory/decisions.json`.
